# Kol Tregaskes Photography

> Photography archive by Kol Tregaskes. The public gallery is staged until the curated image set is imported with captions, dates, responsive assets, and alt text.

## Pages

- [Homepage](/): Portfolio status, archive routes, and launch gate notes
- [Gallery](/gallery.html): Gallery staging status with category filters
- [News](/news.html): Photography digest archive from the shared estate news pipeline
- [Topics](/topics.html): Topic-led view of the available photography digests
- [Blog](/blog.html): Portfolio notes and publication updates
- [Why the Gallery Is Staged Before Launch](/blog-portfolio-sync-note.html): Transparent status note for the image import
- [About](/about.html): About Kol Tregaskes
- [Contact](/contact.html): Archive, print, and licensing contact only

## About

Kol Tregaskes is a UK-based photographer working across landscape, architecture, urban, and documentary photography. The standalone gallery is not yet promoted as a finished public portfolio.
